name: Mining Monks VR
summary:
Step into the mines like never before in Mining Monks VR, a thrilling VR adventure where danger and discovery go hand in hand. Grab your pickaxe, dive deep into mysterious caves, and uncover hidden treasures while monsters lurk in the shadows.

Whether youre chasing to be rich or outsmarting terrifying creatures or just having fun with friends, every expedition is an unpredictable journey. Go it alone for a true test of courage or team up in multiplayer to double the adventure.
